history.submitter_remarks: Former name attested in G.N.1131 rename notice; replaces description in G.N.1311 of 1977.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Road commencing at its junction with Clear Water Bay Road near milestone 11 and running in a north-easterly direction for about 120 metres, then it turns to run in an east-north-easterly direction for about 450 metres, it then turns in an east-south-easterly direction for about 200 metres where it bends sharply to run in a north-north-westerly direction for about 140 metres and then turns to run in a north-westerly direction for about 180 metres, it then bends sharply to run easterly for about 70 metres and then turns north-easterly for about 50 metres, then it runs in an easterly direction for about 200 metres where it terminates at a round-about at Ngam Tau Sha as shown coloured red on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R8.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 由與清水灣道近十一咪之連接點，開始向東北伸展約一二〇米，再改向東北偏東伸展約四五〇米，然後改向東南偏東伸展約二〇〇米，至此急遽轉向西北偏北伸展約一四〇米，再改向西北伸展約一八〇米，後急遽轉向東伸展約七十米，再改向東北伸展約五十米，最後轉向東伸展約二〇〇米而止於岩頭沙迴旋處，即NTA/SK/R8號圖內以紅色顯示之部份。
